text: PR #6500 (#6495 concurrency state-sequence hunt) merged as bac49af3, issue closed. Added 4 deterministic state-sequence tests for both required crossings using real lock contention + SET REPROCESS TO n (no production/build changes). Review (Codex+Copilot) caught a real missing-evidence gap in one sequence (could have silently passed without exercising genuine contention) plus tight timing margins; both fixed before merge -- every sequence now asserts on runtime-emitted contention/cancellation evidence. Hunt surfaced a real, not-yet-fixed defect: #6499 (cancellation inside explicit FLOCK()/RLOCK() retry is silently swallowed instead of halting) -- filed, not fixed, per #6495's own scope. Starting #6496 (migration fidelity) next; #6497 remains agent-approved and unstarted.
